# Green Darma Pharmaceuticals

> High-quality, clinical-grade pharmaceutical preparations and healthcare solutions in Bangladesh.

## Organization Information
- Name: Green Darma Pharmaceuticals
- Country: Bangladesh
- Official Website: https://greendarmapharmaceuticals.com
- Industry: Pharmaceuticals & Healthcare

## Core Product Portfolio
- **SCABICOD SOAP** (Permethrin 1% w/w): Medicated soap for scabies treatment and mite elimination.
- **Tinea Soap** (Luliconazole 1%): Broad-spectrum azole antifungal medicated soap bar for ringworm, athlete's foot, and jock itch.
- **SCABVAR Lotion** (Permethrin 5% + Crotamiton 10%): Scabicide and antipruritic lotion for fast itch relief.
- **Greenstar Shampoo** (Ketoconazole 2% + Zinc Pyrithione 1% + Aloe Vera 10%): Anti-dandruff medicated shampoo for seborrhoeic dermatitis.
- **X-Corel G Tablet** (Coral Calcium 600 mg + Vitamin D3 + Magnesium): Bone health supplement for osteoporosis protection and calcium supplementation.
